cards.text: Titan Node 4 is the primary computation unit in rack C12. It has a serial number of TN4-9901 and contains 256GB of RAM. The server is managed by the Infrastructure Team.
The Nexus API provides the primary interface for external services. It currently runs version 2.4.1 and listens on port 8443. The service utilizes HTTPS protocol for all communications.
Lyra Scheduler manages background task orchestration using the Rust language. It monitors specific system cues on port 9090. Version 1.3 was recently deployed to handle increased load.
Orion DB is the main data storage facility with a size of 4.2TB. It runs on the PostgreX engine and performs weekly backups. All sensitive data is encrypted using specialized algorithms.
Project Iota is a research initiative led by Dr. Aris. It operates with a budget of $500,000 and focuses on Class 4 security experiments. The project headquarters is located in the West Wing.
Elara Bot is an automated maintenance unit currently located in Sector G. Its battery is maintained at 92% and it performs daily inspections. The unit received its last major update in August.
Z-Drive 10 is a high-capacity storage unit with a capacity of 50TB. It is currently in an active state following recent maintenance. The firmware version installed is v3.2.
Vector Sync is a data synchronization tool configured with an interval of 30 seconds. It uses AES-256 encryption and allows for 5 retries on failure. Configuration files are stored locally on node 4.
